Chapter 347 - 347 I've Already Made It; Choose!

347 I’ve Already Made It; Choose!

“Yeah, we don’t deserve it.”

Back then, when he encountered many unsolvable problems in the experiment, Professor Wu Tian kept asking Zheng Qian to ask Lin Fan for help.

At that time, Zheng Qian felt that Wu Tian was desperate.

Yes, Lin Fan was indeed an incredible genius.

He solved several math problems and invented the earthquake prediction device and the super battery.

However, nobody was perfect. Lin Fan could not possibly be perfect in every aspect, right?

After all, she had never heard of him doing any research or having any achievements in biomedicine.

However…

Due to Professor Wu Tian’s repeated pleas, Zheng Qian had the mentality of fulfilling his wishes. That was why she found Hu Tian and met Lin Fan a few days ago.

Who would have thought that in just a few days, Lin Fan would write the Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine and successfully publish it on Nature?!

Lin Fan even wrote her and Professor Wu Tian’s names as the second authors.

If the data from the Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine were used to develop the hormone recovery medicine, it would be possible for patients to be cured completely.

This was definitely a thesis worthy of winning the Nobel Prize!

Her name had appeared as the second author of the Nobel Prize-level thesis…

When Zheng Qian thought of this, she was so excited that her face turned red.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “If you hadn’t let me watch that experiment, I wouldn’t have been able to write this thesis. So, it’s normal for me to write your names.”

Lin Fan was definitely not spouting nonsense.

After all, watching the biology experiment was one of the conditions to complete the mission.

“You’re too humble,” Wu Tian said. “Even if you hadn’t watched the experiment, you would’ve still gotten inspiration from somewhere.”

Obviously, he thought that Lin Fan had been inspired by the experiment, which helped him write the thesis.

When solving some difficult problems, some people would suddenly have a flash of inspiration when they were eating, talking, or seeing something. Thus, they could easily solve difficult problems… Such examples were not rare.

It was counselor Sun Yaodong!

“Lin Fan, that’s great. So you’re in school!” Sun Yaodong said happily after seeing Lin Fan.

He walked in front of Lin Fan and patted his shoulder. “Not bad, not bad! You published a paper in Science a while ago, and now you’ve published a paper in Nature too…

“Back then, I graduated too early. Otherwise, I would have done the same.”

When Sun Yaodong said this, his face faintly revealed a touch of aftertaste and regret.

It was as if he could publish a paper in Nature and Science if he hadn’t graduated so soon.

Professor Wu Tian could not help but cough.

Only then did Sun Yaodong notice that Wu Tian and Zheng Qian were also in the classroom. He could not help but say awkwardly, “Uh… Lin Fan, Chancellor Shen Liang wants to invite you to his office.”

Lin Fan said,” Alright, I’ll go over now.”

As he spoke, he walked out.

After Lin Fan left, Wu Tian, Zheng Qian, and Sun Yaodong did not have any intention of staying in the classroom.

Instantly, the entire classroom was filled with heated discussions.

“F*ck! Brother Lin Fan is too awesome!”

“Brother Lin Fan!!!”

“Excuse me, where can I get a copy of Nature?”

…

Lin Fan was completely unaware of the reactions of the students in the classroom.

At this moment, he had already arrived outside the chancellor’s office.

He raised his hand and gently knocked on the door a few times.

Soon, a deep voice sounded from inside. “Please come in!”

When Lin Fan heard that, he pushed open the door.

At this moment, there were two people sitting in the office. One of them was Chancellor Shen Liang.

The other person was someone whom Lin Fan had interacted with before, the director of the Academy of Sciences, Feng Yuxiang.

“Lin Fan, you’re here. Sit down.” Shen Liang said with a smile. As he spoke, he even personally poured a cup of tea for Lin Fan.

Shen Liang was the chancellor of Jiangbei University. In terms of rank, he was not inferior to the leaders of Jiangbei University.

Now, however, he was personally pouring tea for Lin Fan.

One could imagine how high Lin Fan’s position was in Shen Liang’s heart.

“Hello, Lin Fan. Do you still remember me?” Feng Yuxiang said.

“Hello, Director Feng.” Lin Fan nodded.

“It’s great that you remember me. I don’t like to beat about the bush, so I’ll be straightforward.”

“Actually, I came from Jingbei today to look for you,” Feng Yuxiang said. “I heard that you published a paper in Nature called Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine.”

Lin Fan looked at Feng Yuxiang in surprise. This news spread really fast.

Then, he nodded.

“Then are you confident in developing a drug to treat diabetes?” Feng Yuxiang asked directly.

After saying this, he held his breath and pricked up his ears. His eyes stared at Lin Fan without blinking.

It was because this matter… was too important!

“You want to develop a medicine to treat diabetes?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes!” Feng Yuxiang said.

“I’ve already done it,” Lin Fan said.

Whoosh!

Feng Yuxiang stood up abruptly and said in a trembling voice, “You… You mean… You’ve already invented it?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

Then, he took out the human islet recovery medicine from his pocket.

Feng Yuxiang said, “This… This is…”

“This is the human islet recovery medicine. It can be used to treat diabetic patients,” Lin Fan said.

Although Feng Yuxiang had already guessed it, he was still extremely excited after getting Lin Fan’s confirmation. He said excitedly, “Good, good, good! Haha!”

After a while, Feng Yuxiang suppressed the excitement in his heart and asked, “Can I take this with me?”

“No problem,” Lin Fan said.

Feng Yuxiang held the medicine tightly in his arms as if he were holding a peerless treasure, afraid that it would fall to the ground and shatter.

“There’s one more thing… Lin Fan, can I ask you for a favor? Can you try to let a Hua Nation company be the main sales channel for this human islet recovery medicine?” Feng Yuxiang said. “Of course, you can also register your own company for sales.

“I also know that this may be a little difficult for you, but the country will give you some convenience and compensation.”

The pharmaceutical companies in Hua Nation could only be considered above average internationally.

As a result, many drugs were often snatched by foreign countries.

If Lin Fan was able to let a Hua Nation company be in charge of the human islet recovery medicine, then it was definitely good news for the medical industry in Hua Nation!

However, Lin Fan might lose some benefits.

This was because once this drug appeared, countless foreign pharmaceutical giants would definitely pay a sky-high price to buy the agency rights.

Lin Fan naturally understood what Feng Yuxiang meant.

A sky-high price?

10 billion?

100 billion?

Sorry, he really did not lack it.

Hence, Lin Fan said, “Forget it. If I register my own company, that’ll be too troublesome… As for letting a Hua Nation company take charge of the medicine…”

Suddenly, Lin Fan thought of Liu Yuhang, who had called him yesterday.

Did Liu Yuhang and Sun Luguo not own pharmaceutical companies?

Thinking of this, Lin Fan continued, “I’ve already thought of some Hua Nation companies that I can work with.”

Feng Yuxiang stood up, bent over, and said in an extremely solemn tone, “Thank you, Lin Fan!”
